properties.description:
Your Cohere-powered R&D knowledge mining workflow is deployed.

Launch the application
In the managed application menu, open Settings > Parameters and Outputs, then select frontendUrl. This is the primary application URL. Service endpoints are available as apiUrl and mcpUrl.

Microsoft Foundry
Use foundryProjectEndpoint to connect to the project and foundryProjectResourceId to open or automate against its Azure resource. The deployed resources and models are identified by foundryAccountName, foundryProjectName, modelDeploymentName, embedDeploymentName, embedModelName, rerankDeploymentName, and rerankModelName.

Retrieval and document storage
Azure AI Search details are available as searchServiceName and searchServiceEndpoint. Azure Storage details are available as storageAccountName, blobServiceUri, and documentsContainerName.

Provisioning jobs
Use policySeedJobName and provisioningJobName to monitor post-deployment initialization.

Optional Fabric integration
When Fabric integration is enabled, use fabricWorkspaceName and fabricWorkspaceId to identify the workspace, and fabricLakehouseName and fabricLakehouseId to identify the lakehouse.

Deployment readiness
Post-deployment policy seeding and Foundry agent provisioning can take 15-30 minutes. If the application is not ready immediately, wait for those jobs to finish and try again.
